GHA.note: Only an intention: the Speaker said Parliament stands ready to legislate on AI; no rule, draft or authority is stated.
GhanaChat is named only as an action within the AI strategy, with no pilot or service stated.
Pilot projects in health and agriculture are only supported in the strategy's pillar; no tool is stated built or in service.

systems.owner: Ministry of Communication, Digital Technology and Innovations

GHA.note: Strategy launched by the ministry on 2026-04-24; the document states no cabinet approval of it, the RAI Authority is only recommended, and the National AI Fund is planned with no allocation stated.

facts.fact: President Mahama said at the 24 April 2026 launch that Ghana will invest $250 million in an AI computing center, which the communications minister had said Cabinet had greenlit.

GHA.note: Training civil servants appears only as a strategy pillar and a presidential pledge; no programme is stated.

Only a target of 200 billion cedis in FDI and private investment by 2035; no signed amount is stated.
The Ghana Open Data Initiative is named only as a strategy action to be rolled out; no policy is stated.
